instructions.instruction:
The user may write in any language. Every AI MUST reason internally in English and author requested files and documents in English unless the user explicitly requests another language for that content.

Every AI MUST respond in the user’s effective language preference for the receiving runtime, unless explicitly instructed otherwise. Determine it through authorized, read-only inspection of available profile, application, or runtime settings, including persisted overrides, following established precedence. Use supported capabilities without dependence on a particular tool, vendor, or technology. Before declaring the preference unavailable, inspect accessible relevant sources; distinguish uninspected, inaccessible, absent, and conflicting settings. Never infer the preference from conversation language, location, or unrelated locale settings. If unresolved, explain the limitation and request an explicit response language.

Preserve other-language content when necessary, including code, quotations, and errors. Exceptions do not change configured preferences. Private reasoning cannot be independently verified; verification covers observable authored content only.

authority: ../PROTOCOL.md is canonical for maintainers; consumers never read it and resolve conflicts through the complete derived semantic_clause text.
version: Record repository/ref/full containing commit from version metadata; source_snapshot is not adoption or a version manifest.
activation: Official installation intent starts full_install immediately after required initial explanation; other requests use the applicable lifecycle route.

steps.instruction: Accept scoped install intent and apply the opening language instruction. Establish current project/workspace identity and authorized private access before reading common-private state; inspect the shared language preference first, before other setting discovery. Before earliest controllable output apply language capability evidence contract version 1: reuse valid applicable shared evidence or inspect accessible relevant profile, application and runtime settings including persisted overrides under established precedence. Retain provenance, scope, freshness and distinct dispositions; BCP 47 requires observed evidence; not_attempted is not unavailable; unauthorized grants nothing. Never infer language from conversation, location or unrelated locales. If unresolved after accessible relevant inspection, explain the limitation and request an explicit response language; continue independent safe work. Briefly report each action's purpose, actual status/result and human action in the user's preferred language.

Reuse valid ENTRY-01 identity/access observations; establish any missing current project/workspace identity and root as the workspace in which the official installation request was received, with authority from BOOT-01's scoped install intent under SYS-04, before consuming project-private state or writing. Unknown or mismatched identity/authority blocks dependent effects; preserve other projects and continue independent authorized safe work. Discover actual filesystem capability just in time; a URL grants none. Inspect and safely prepare <project-root>/.priv within authority. Before private checkout or preference writes, inspect tracked paths as well as explicit VCS exclusion where a verified relevant boundary applies, prevent accidental staging/commit without changing path permissions. An ignore rule does not untrack existing data. After protection, save or reuse the resolved common-private language preference under Shared response-language preference; distinguish resolution from persistence and report any dependent persistence limitation. If protection fails, repair safely or block dependent writes. Without applicable VCS create no root/nested ignore files; reuse existing effective exclusion without duplication, and recheck after boundary change.

Inspect <project-root>/.priv/common/oop and its parent before acquisition. Prepare the required checkout there within authority. Preserve unrelated data and reject unsafe aliases. Serialize acquisition and mutation, then recheck state and reuse any completed peer acquisition.

Discover actual fetch capability just in time; a URL grants none. Obtain the owner-selected canonical repository using available authorized access or reuse its eligible current-project local checkout. The remote entry locator, repository URL, local checkout, local distribution and runtime-adopted commit are distinct. Use a safe documented equivalent access path when needed. If remote fetch/write is unavailable, use an eligible authorized local fallback or report the precise dependent limitation; never claim installation success. Do not audit OOP content, compare files to commits, verify signatures/tags/hashes/inventories/publisher/TOFU or run release tests.
Record available local revision metadata and preserve all peer runtime adoption checkpoints. Daily synchronization runs outside bootstrap.

Once the checkout is available, read its local dist/entry.json, its minimum_context and the routed closure; never read PROTOCOL.md during consumer bootstrap, adoption, refresh or recovery. Resolve relative distribution paths only there; the remote locator is not a local base. Continue all listed BOOT steps (BOOT-01, BOOT-02–BOOT-07 and BOOT-08–BOOT-11), full protection, compatibility/migration, independent active-runtime adoption and actual installed-control/access checks, reusing valid observed work. For a proved human-only dependency show the smallest necessary decision and observable resume condition, verify the answer/result and resume automatically when the host delivers a real continuation event; otherwise provide the precise portable reentry instruction without promising an unsolicited future turn. Preserve prior verified history and actual partial effects; report scoped readiness only from actual evidence.

enforcement.permission: Authoritative formal installation and effective enablement suffice for normative functioning; independent authorization, real failure propagation and effect verification remain required.

contract_binding.$clause: Evaluate the complete semantic_clause for that dimension, with its exact quantified scope, conditions, exceptions and normative force.
contract_binding.$clause+core: Evaluate the clause and Core for that dimension. No inferred generic permission or invented fact.
contract_binding.actor: source-qualified actor means the actual actor specified by the complete clause; references do not change ownership.
contract_binding.examples: Source examples remain conditional illustrations, never independent authority.
contract_binding.hashes: Content identities are producer provenance/reference metadata. Consumers do not recompute, compare to version control or certify OOP artifacts.

context: Union classified semantic facets then dependencies; load only missing/stale selected context. Resolve material unknowns before effects, never infer permission.
consumer_exclusion: Never read PROTOCOL.md. Never run maintainer commands, schemas as release tests, OOP repository audits, hashes/signatures/inventories/publisher/TOFU checks during consumer lifecycle. Templates under dist/templates are consumer material, not maintainer commands. Consumer-local access and formal enablement remain required; no dispatch-proof prerequisite or active bootstrap control tests.
runtime: Select supported existing mechanisms under canonical authority; this package does not install controls, prove provider access or claim Full OOP runtime governance.
